# The vocabulary

Every part's states and CSS variables. A state is an attribute on the part's element: style
it with an attribute selector (`.panel[data-open]`). A variable is a custom property on the
element: read it with `var()`. The names follow Base UI's.

## Accordion

### Accordion.Root

Groups the items.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the items are laid out, and the arrows that move between their triggers. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Accordion.Item

One section: a header with its trigger, and a panel.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when the item is open. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Accordion.Header

The heading that holds the trigger.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when the item is open. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Accordion.Trigger

The button that opens and closes the item's panel.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-panel-open` | Present when the item's panel is open. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Accordion.Panel

The item's content. In the page while open, and through its exit's motion.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the items are laid out, and the arrows that move between their triggers. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--accordion-panel-height` | The panel's content height while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open. |
| `--accordion-panel-width` | The panel's content width while it opens or closes, `auto` once it is open. |

## Checkbox

### Checkbox.Root

The box. It holds a hidden native checkbox, which a form and a label reach.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-checked` | Present when it is checked. |
| `data-unchecked` | Present when it is not checked. |
| `data-indeterminate` | Present when it is neither checked nor unchecked. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs it. |

### Checkbox.Indicator

The mark. In the page while the box is checked or indeterminate.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-checked` | Present when it is checked. |
| `data-unchecked` | Present when it is not checked. |
| `data-indeterminate` | Present when it is neither checked nor unchecked. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-readonly` | Present when it can be read but not changed. |
| `data-required` | Present when the form needs it. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |

## Dialog

### Dialog.Trigger

The button that opens the dialog.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the dialog is open. |

### Dialog.Backdrop

The layer over the page behind the dialog.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |

### Dialog.Popup

The dialog itself.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-nested-dialog-open` | Present when another dialog is open above this one. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--nested-dialogs` | How many dialogs are open above this one. |

### Dialog.Title

The heading that names the dialog.

### Dialog.Description

The text that describes the dialog.

### Dialog.Close

A button that closes the dialog.

## HoverCard

### HoverCard.Trigger

The link the card previews.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the card is open. |

### HoverCard.Positioner

Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--anchor-width` | The anchor's width. |
| `--anchor-height` | The anchor's height. |
| `--available-width` | The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--available-height` | The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--transform-origin` | The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from. |

### HoverCard.Popup

The card itself.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-instant` (delay, focus, dismiss) | Present when it opened or closed without its usual wait, for a design that skips the motion then. |

### HoverCard.Arrow

An element that points at the trigger, placed along the popup's edge.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |
| `data-uncentered` | Present when the popup was pushed along its edge, so the arrow is not at the trigger's centre. |

## Select

### Select.Trigger

The button that shows the value and opens the list.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-popup-open` | Present when the list is open. |
| `data-placeholder` | Present while nothing is chosen. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Select.Value

The chosen value's label, or the placeholder.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-placeholder` | Present while nothing is chosen. |

### Select.Positioner

Places the list against the trigger. It carries the geometry.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--anchor-width` | The anchor's width. |
| `--anchor-height` | The anchor's height. |
| `--available-width` | The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--available-height` | The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport. |
| `--transform-origin` | The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from. |

### Select.Popup

The list of items.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-open` | Present when it is open. |
| `data-closed` | Present when it is closed. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
| `data-side` (top, right, bottom, left) | The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. |
| `data-align` (start, center, end) | How it is aligned with the anchor. |

### Select.Item

One choice in the list.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-selected` | Present on the chosen item. |
| `data-highlighted` | Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |

### Select.ItemText

The item's name: what the trigger shows once it is chosen.

### Select.ItemIndicator

A mark an item shows while it is the chosen one.

## Tabs

### Tabs.Root

Groups the tabs and their panels.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the tabs are laid out. |
| `data-activation-direction` (left, right, up, down, none) | Where the newly active tab is from the one before, for a panel or a mark that slides. |

### Tabs.List

The row of tabs. The arrows move between them.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the tabs are laid out. |
| `data-activation-direction` (left, right, up, down, none) | Where the newly active tab is from the one before, for a panel or a mark that slides. |

### Tabs.Tab

A button that shows its panel.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-active` | Present on the tab whose panel is shown. |
| `data-disabled` | Present when it is disabled. |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the tabs are laid out. |

### Tabs.Indicator

A mark for the active tab: it carries that tab's position and size.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the tabs are laid out. |
| `data-activation-direction` (left, right, up, down, none) | Where the newly active tab is from the one before, for a panel or a mark that slides. |

| Variable | Holds |
| --- | --- |
| `--active-tab-left` | The active tab's distance from the list's left edge. |
| `--active-tab-right` | The active tab's distance from the list's right edge. |
| `--active-tab-top` | The active tab's distance from the list's top edge. |
| `--active-tab-bottom` | The active tab's distance from the list's bottom edge. |
| `--active-tab-width` | The active tab's width. |
| `--active-tab-height` | The active tab's height. |

### Tabs.Panel

A tab's content. In the page while its tab is active, and through its exit.

| Attribute | When |
| --- | --- |
| `data-hidden` | Present while its tab is not the active one. |
| `data-orientation` (horizontal, vertical) | The way the tabs are laid out. |
| `data-activation-direction` (left, right, up, down, none) | Where the newly active tab is from the one before, for a panel or a mark that slides. |
| `data-starting-style` | Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from. |
| `data-ending-style` | Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends. |
